title: glochidion khasicum
intro: Glochidion khasicum, commonly known as the Indian swamp mustard or Indian staff tree, is a plant species that belongs to the Euphorbiaceae family, which is a type of flowering plant. The health benefits of Glochidion khasicum include its potential to reduce inflammation, manage diabetes, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Therapeutic actions of the plant include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic activities, which may help in preventing various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Glochidion khasicum include flavonoids, saponins, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
